commands.name: Back
commands.description: Return to your main Stream Deck keys.

commands.name: New chat
commands.description: Start a new chat in the ChatGPT desktop app (opens the app if it is closed).

commands.name: Send
commands.description: Send the message in the ChatGPT message box by pressing the app's own Send button.

commands.name: 5h session
commands.description: Shows how much of your ChatGPT/Codex 5-hour usage window is used, as a percentage, with the time until it resets. Press to refresh now. Read from the app's own records on this PC; no sign-in needed.

commands.name: Weekly
commands.description: Shows how much of your ChatGPT/Codex weekly usage limit is used, as a percentage, with the time until it resets. Press to refresh now. Read from the app's own records on this PC; no sign-in needed.

commands.name: Temporary
commands.description: Start a temporary chat that is not saved to your history (Ctrl+Shift+N). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Search
commands.description: Open the command menu to search chats and commands (Ctrl+K). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Usage
commands.description: Open your usage and limits in the ChatGPT app settings. The plugin never reads your account data.

commands.name: Models
commands.description: Open the model picker (Ctrl+Shift+M). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Projects
commands.description: Open the project picker (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+O). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Sidebar
commands.description: Show or hide the sidebar (Ctrl+B). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Previous
commands.description: Go to the previous chat or tab (Ctrl+Shift+Tab). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Next
commands.description: Go to the next chat or tab (Ctrl+Tab). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Chat
commands.description: Switch the app to Chat (Alt+1). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Work
commands.description: Switch the app to Work (Alt+2). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Codex
commands.description: Switch the app to Codex (Alt+3). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Dictate
commands.description: Bring ChatGPT to the front and start Windows voice typing (Win+H) in the message box.

commands.name: More
commands.description: Show the second page of ChatGPT keys.

commands.name: Main
commands.description: Back to the first page of ChatGPT keys.

commands.name: Settings
commands.description: Open Settings in the ChatGPT desktop app.

commands.name: Shortcuts
commands.description: Show the app's keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+/). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Find
commands.description: Find text in the current chat (Ctrl+F). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Quick chat
commands.description: Open a quick chat (Ctrl+Alt+N). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Archive
commands.description: Archive the current chat (Ctrl+Shift+A). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Pin
commands.description: Pin or unpin the current chat (Ctrl+Alt+P). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Rename
commands.description: Rename the current chat (Ctrl+Alt+R). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Copy link
commands.description: Copy a link to the current chat (Ctrl+Alt+L). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Skills
commands.description: Open Skills in the ChatGPT desktop app.

commands.name: Scheduled
commands.description: Open scheduled tasks in the ChatGPT desktop app.

commands.name: Full view
commands.description: Enter or leave full view (Ctrl+Shift+F). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Zoom in
commands.description: Make the text larger (Ctrl+=). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Zoom out
commands.description: Make the text smaller (Ctrl+-). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Reset zoom
commands.description: Reset the text size (Ctrl+0). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Go back
commands.description: Navigate back (Ctrl+[). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Go forward
commands.description: Navigate forward (Ctrl+]). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Copy
commands.description: Copy (Ctrl+C). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Paste
commands.description: Paste (Ctrl+V). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Undo
commands.description: Undo the last app action (Ctrl+Z). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Redo
commands.description: Redo the last app action (Ctrl+Y). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Full screen
commands.description: Toggle full screen (F11). Brings ChatGPT to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Focus app
commands.description: Bring the ChatGPT window to the front.

commands.name: Custom key
commands.description: Send any shortcut you type in the key settings, for example Ctrl+Alt+1. Win+<key> works too.
